title: spec-property-retirement playbook: no order between a key removal and the separate skills card that stops teaching it
body:
domain:skills#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaqHXh17Qc3C7MRAQw

Filing gate: ① documentation defect with a named producer, raised at ACCEPT of PR #32486 (#32179, ruling record 6797014134 letter B). ⛔ Not a claim; triage decides lane and grade. The contract reviewer (6811091643 ③) called this a sequencing question for the maintainer, so triage may route it to the decision box.

## The text

`.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` checklist (L286 on `main`): 「已发布 skills —— 教这个键的 `skills/*/SKILL.md`(表格、`defineX` 示例)」 lists the published skills among a retirement's surfaces, gated by `check:skill-examples` and `check:skill-refs`.

## Why it needs a rule now

Under ruling B the published-skills edit is its own `domain:skills` card, never in the implementation PR. A key removal turns `check:skill-examples` red in its own PR while a published skill still teaches the key, so the two cards need an order (skills card first, or the removal PR waits on it). The playbook does not say which.

## Reach

Every spec-property retirement that a published skill teaches.

## Duplicate check

Carried as `carrier: the domain:skills seat` in PR #32486's Acceptance notes; no open card.
